legacy_root.answer: CrewAI sequential crews map to ordered IR stages with a Boolean stop tasks_completed >= task_count. AutoGen GroupChat termination maps to is_termination_msg OR round_index == last_round OR speaker_selection_none OR reply_is_none. Live conversational loops (hierarchical manager delegation, allow_delegation, auto/manual/random speaker selection, run_chat itself, human_input ALWAYS/TERMINATE) are NON-TRANSFERABLE. CrewAI Agent.role job titles extend the council vocabulary; Reviewer and Critic and GroupChatManager map onto reviewer/critic/chair.

Boolean stopping grammar agrees with the documented oracles on 20 synthetic states; an AND-for-OR plant is detected.
